description: This file defines a logger utility class 'Log' that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It manages a chain of LogNodes to handle actual logging output and supplies helper methods for different log levels. The class also defines constants for log levels, which are linked to Android's native Log class.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static logging methods that delegate to a chain of LogNodes, allowing flexible log handling and formatting.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log messages will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message to the current LogNode with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion (fatal) message, optionally with an exception.
